results.description:
When New Orleans police declare private investigator Max Lamoreaux’s missing godson a runaway, he reaches out to former flame Theresa Crawford for help.  Her specialized skills have proven key to unlocking past investigations.  Time hasn’t diminished their powerful chemistry, but Theresa’s secrets drove them apart once before.  As they work together, will shadows from her past destroy their last chance at happiness?  

“Kathy Ivan’s books are addictive, you can’t read just one!”  Susan Stoker, NYT and USA TODAY Bestselling Author

"Kathy Ivan has crafted warm, engaging characters that will steal your heart and a mystery that will keep you reading to the very last page."  Barb Han, USA TODAY and Publisher's Weekly Bestselling Author

“This is the first I have read from Kathy Ivan and it won't be the last.” Night Owl Reviews

"I highly recommend Desperate Choices. Readers can’t go wrong here!” Melissa, Joyfully Reviewed
